quickAnswer: Marksman + rifle path for solo DPS, Tactician + Medic for team stability, Marksman for credit farming, Tactician + Necromancer for high-wave pushes, Necromancer for leaderboard attempts.

decisions: Pick role first, weapon second — class abilities outweigh raw weapon DPS for most of the run.
Anchor before you scale — Tactician lets Marksman or Necromancer farm safely.
Save aggressively for class unlocks — Demolitionist 50k, Tactician 75k, Bastion 200k, Necromancer 250k.
Auto Skip only after the team is ahead — skipping into an unstoppable wave is the most common loadout failure.

faq.question: What is the best loadout for solo play?
faq.answer: Marksman with the rifle path — Deadeye pierce and Sonar Ping carry kill rate without a team anchor. Necromancer overtakes once you afford 250,000 Credits.

faq.question: What is the best team comp?
faq.answer: Tactician (anchor) + Marksman (carry) + Medic (sustain) is the workhorse comp. Add Necromancer for leaderboard runs.

faq.question: How long to unlock Necromancer?
faq.answer: 250,000 Credits permanent unlock. Average session ~13 minutes per Roblox API — expect several strong runs plus the Zombies code (2,500 Credits).

faq.question: Did Rooftop Map change loadouts?
faq.answer: Yes. Lane-hold loadouts with Tactician barricades and Necromancer funnel plays rank higher than open-field Medic or Ninja stealth routes.
